column2: There is one misleading aspect to this visualisation: the rightmost bar for the ultrawealthy should get much, much narrower as it goes up (essentially microscopic on the x-axis scale). This matters because for the main part the area under the curve represents the total wealth in the country but when you start scrolling up the area is massively more than the wealth it is representing.

Main discussion:

Wealth Inequality in America drawn to scale

https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50270764
How does the graph data calculate wealth in case of assets such as a mortgage, 401k, credit card, etc?

I feel that modern society has grown just about enough to mostly stop blaming the impoverished for their own poverty, but the zeitgeist in the US has still not grown that much beyond the red scare. None of the possible solutions to the US's relentless financial punishment regime will be accepted fast enough for the people suffering now to benefit from them.
